WITH literacy_changes AS (
  SELECT
    "District",
    NULLIF("Women age 15-49 years who are literate (%)"::FLOAT, 0) AS literacy_4,
    NULLIF(LEAD("Women age 15-49 years who are literate (%)"::FLOAT, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY "District" ORDER BY "Survey Round"), 0) AS literacy_5
  FROM district_health_factsheet
  WHERE "State" IN ('Bihar', 'Jharkhand', 'Odisha')
    AND "District" IN ('Bhojpur', 'Cuttack', 'Dumka', 'Ganjam', 'Gaya', 'Giridih', 'Gumla', 'Hazaribagh', 'Kalahandi', 'Kishanganj', 'Koraput', 'Madhubani', 'Mayurbhanj', 'Nalanda', 'Palamu', 'Purnia', 'Ranchi', 'Rayagada', 'Rohtas', 'Saran')
    AND "Survey Round" IN ('NFHS-4', 'NFHS-5')
)
SELECT "District"
FROM literacy_changes
WHERE literacy_5 < literacy_4
